profile.name: ACQ2106 模块化高速数据采集机箱
profile.name_en: ACQ2106 modular high-speed data acquisition chassis
profile.description: ACQ2106 是一类模块化高速数据采集机箱，用于承载多通道采集模块并进行统一的时钟、触发和同步管理。它常用于实验室中的瞬态信号记录、波形采集以及需要多设备同步的测量场景。
profile.description_en: The ACQ2106 is a modular high-speed data acquisition chassis that hosts multi-channel acquisition modules and provides centralized clock, trigger, and synchronization control. It is commonly used in laboratories for transient recording, waveform capture, and synchronized measurements across multiple devices.
